title: [Run] Global sort order score modifier seems to have no effect
author: laundmo

status.label: Existing upstream fix
status.detail: PR 51195 addresses the score modifier range versus built-in result score tiers.

next_action.label: Review PR 51195
next_action.reason: The issue has an open targeted implementation rather than an outstanding reporter evidence request.

judgment.rationale: The public reproduction and many confirmations establish a ranking problem. Open PR 51195 explicitly fixes this issue by expanding the score modifier control's range; another design would duplicate that work.
evidence: The body reproduces with Shell and Program enabled globally and different score modifiers.
Discussion includes Settings outranking Program even at the previous +/-1000 limits, plus cases where a large modifier helped.
https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/51195 is OPEN and explicitly fixes 20446; its description compares 5000/10500 base score tiers with the former +/-1000 UI range.
judgment.recommended_action: Review the targeted range change and its ordering/selection tests; do not request a generic diagnostic ZIP or duplicate the implementation.

fix_assessment.rationale: Open PR 51195 covers the inability of allowed modifiers to overcome high built-in scores. Modifiers remain additive, not strict plugin priorities.

issue_context.summary: PowerToys Run users cannot reliably prioritize Program results over Shell/Windows Settings within the existing modifier range; an open PR expands that range.
known_information: The original report supplies plugin settings, reproduction steps, and a screenshot.
All 24 comments were read, including later confirmations and the partial high-weight workaround.
PR 51195 changes the Settings control to +/-20000 and adds targeted ordering/selection tests.
inferences: The score-range explanation accounts for conflicting reports that raising the weight helps some result pairs but not others.
issue_context.analysis: Existing public implementation coverage is stronger than a stale generic evidence request. The PR's own validation claims are not an independent verification or a shipped fix.
initial_investigation: Read complete issue discussion and cross-reference timeline, including closed related ranking reports.
Read PR 51195's complete description and changed-file list, including Settings XAML and Wox ordering tests.
